facts.text: Inherited parent claims are not repeated: "PrivateLink exists in Atlas" and "traffic is encrypted by AWS". The second one is challenged under Disagreements.

In scope: how AWS PrivateLink works on the inside. That covers its parts (endpoint service, interface endpoint, endpoint network interface, Network Load Balancer), the connection lifecycle, DNS behaviour, the invariants it guarantees, and its hard limits. It also covers how Atlas maps a cluster onto those parts, because that is the child delta under the parent.
